description: This file defines functions and procedures for configuring, setting up, and tearing down a network connection using a modem via the NCM protocol in OpenWrt. It includes initialization, modem communication, and network interface management.

methods.name: proto_ncm_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the configuration parameters for the NCM protocol, setting default values and adding configuration options.

methods.name: proto_ncm_setup
methods.description: Sets up the network interface by configuring the modem, establishing connection, and creating network interfaces for IPv4 and IPv6.

methods.name: proto_ncm_teardown
methods.description: Tears down the network interface by disconnecting the modem and cleaning up resources.
